notes: ACCESS: jossandmain.com answered plain curl_cffi impersonation (HTTP 200) on every request this session using safari15_5 as the first profile tried, no rotation needed, ~2s pacing between requests, no CAPTCHA/WAF interstitial encountered. robots.txt was fetched FIRST: single 'User-agent: *' group, no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot group anywhere and no site-wide 'Disallow: /' -> not blocked. It explicitly Allows '/*/sb0/' '/*/sb1/' '/*/sb2/' (every leaf URL below is an /sb0/ listing) while Disallowing generic '/*/sb*/'; '/cat/' hub pages are unmentioned (default allow). PLATFORM: the homepage HTML carries class="hb-theme-jossandmain" and data-app-name="@wayfair/sf-ui-core-funnel" and is served from assets.wfcdn.com -- confirmed independently (not assumed) that Joss & Main runs the same Wayfair-family sf-ui-core-funnel platform documented for Wayfair (b1.json), Birch Lane (b202.json) and AllModern (b201.json): same /cat/ hub + /sb0/ leaf URL shape, same BlockBuilderCategoryStandardCategoryNavigation React/RSC payload embedded in server HTML. TREE: located the Bathroom department hub via the site's own category sitemap (https://www.jossandmain.com/seo-category-sitemap~0.xml, 166 /cat/ URLs total) by matching 'bath': https://www.jossandmain.com/bathroom/cat/bathroom-c1875712.html. Its categoryNavigation payload lists exactly 3 children, all walked: (1) Bathroom Fixtures & Hardware (c1859281, 5 children: Bathroom Sink Faucets, Bathroom Hardware Sets, Cabinet Knobs & Pulls [itself a /cat/ sub-hub with 2 further children], Floor & Wall Tile, Tubs & Whirlpools), (2) Bathroom Vanities & Mirrors (c1875713, 3 children: Bathroom Vanities, Bathroom & Medicine Cabinets [itself a /cat/ sub-hub with 2 further children: Bathroom Cabinets, Medicine Cabinets], Vanity Mirrors), (3) Bath Linens & Accessories (c1872490, 6 children: Bath Towels, Bath Mats, Countertop Bathroom Accessories, Shower Curtains, Vanity Mirrors [same URL/categoryId 1862978 as under hub 2 -- single record per rule 28], Baskets, Bins & Boxes). All 5 hub pages (the top hub, its 3 direct children, and the 2 further /cat/ sub-hubs Cabinet Knobs & Pulls and Bathroom & Medicine Cabinets) were fetched and their own categoryGroups payload read; none had additional nesting beyond what is listed here. The 166-URL category sitemap was scanned in full for any other 'bath' node and returned only the 6 URLs already covered by this tree (the top hub plus its 5 named /cat/ hub pages) -- no sitemap-only node was found. QTY: every leaf number is the page's own rendered 'N Items' header text, verified to appear twice per page (once as the visible header, once in an adjacent aria-label/duplicate DOM node) and matched character-for-character; H1/title tag was checked against the requested node name on every leaf (no bad-slug mismatches found; two pages, Bathroom Hardware Sets and Tubs & Whirlpools, render without an explicit <link rel=canonical> tag but their <title> exactly names the requested category, which was accepted as the identity check per rule this project uses elsewhere). CLASSIFICATION: Bathroom Sink Faucets (103), Bathroom Hardware Sets (34) and Tubs & Whirlpools (48) are genuine Bathroom fixtures/hardware per rules 6/8/17, no dedup hit. Countertop Bathroom Accessories (52) verified by product aria-labels (Soap/Lotion Dispenser, Bathroom Tray, Soap Dish, Tissue Box Cover, Toothbrush Holder, Bathroom Storage Container, Tumbler) -- genuine bathroom accessories per rule 13, no dedup hit. Cabinet & Drawer Knobs (88) and Cabinet & Drawer Pulls (70) are general cabinet hardware, not bathroom-specific fixtures (matches the identical Birch Lane / AllModern precedent for this exact platform's 'Cabinet Knobs & Pulls' node) -- routed out, not recorded as Bathroom rows. Floor & Wall Tile (175, URL lives under /wall-decor-mirrors/) is a building-material tile listing, not a Bathroom product type under rules 3-18 -- routed out. Bath Mats (9) product titles are all 'Cotton Bath Rug' -- textile bath mat per rule 16, routed to Textile. Bath Towels (61) and Shower Curtains (10) routed to Textile per rules 15/20. Baskets, Bins & Boxes (83) product titles are all general decorative/storage baskets and bins (Seagrass Storage Bin, Wicker Basket, Storage Box, Decorative Basket) with zero bathroom-specific items found among 44 unique titles inspected -- general Storage-owned per rules 12/30-33, routed to Storage (same treatment as Birch Lane's 'Laundry Baskets'). CROSS-CATEGORY DEDUP (checked programmatically against cross_category_url_index.json for every candidate leaf URL): Bathroom Vanities (230) already in Furniture.xlsx; Bathroom Cabinets (15) already in Furniture.xlsx and Storage.xlsx; Medicine Cabinets (45) already in Furniture.xlsx and Storage.xlsx; Vanity Mirrors (49) already in Wall_Decor.xlsx; Bath Towels (61) and Bath Mats (9) and Shower Curtains (10) already in Textile.xlsx; Baskets, Bins & Boxes (83) already in Storage.xlsx. All 8 were therefore placed in review[] as ALREADY EXTRACTED, never in rows[], per the mandatory cross-category-dedup addendum (Option-1 rule: a prior category's recorded leaf wins even where bathroom.md's own rules 9/10/12 would otherwise want the node). Because every leaf under 'Bathroom Vanities & Mirrors' dedup'd out, that grouping node was NOT emitted as an is_group row (rule 24/38 -- a group with zero surviving leaves is not written); 'Bathroom Fixtures & Hardware' and 'Bath Linens & Accessories' were each kept as is_group rows because at least one genuine leaf survives under them; 'Cabinet Knobs & Pulls' sub-group was likewise dropped (both its children routed out) and its two children are noted in review only. No View All/Shop All/collection/search/promotional URLs were recorded anywhere.
